Swin2SR represents a possible improvement of the famous SwinIR by Jingyun Liang (kudos for such an amazing contribution ). sources.title: mv-lab/swin2sr | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides an introduction to the Swin2SR repository, which implements a SwinV2 Transformer-based model for image super-resolution and restoration. Swin2SR was presented at the ECCV 2022 AIM Workshop and represents an advancement in transformer-based image enhancement techniques.
